text: Telemea curd is pressed, cut into squares and matured in brine, which makes it crisper, saltier and more flavoured with age; the PDO Telemea de Ibănești is distinguished by brine taken from a local salt-water spring.

steps.note: The curd is pressed overnight, then cut into squares.
The brine is drawn from a local salt-water spring in the Ibănești PDO.
The cheese is matured in brine, and in Ibănești it is fresh after 24 hours.
